verdict.rationale: Square documents in-person acceptance, including Tap to Pay on iPhone without additional hardware and payments on Square hardware. That covers the end goal of taking in-person payments. Nothing in the pack shows the sign-up and approval flow, its timeline, or ordering hardware from the Dashboard, so the same-week onboarding path is unproven. Missing for 10: documented sign-up/approval process and turnaround time, hardware ordering from the Dashboard, evidence of same-week activation, independent corroboration of onboarding speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: Accept contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets in person with Tap to Pay on iPhone.
Process payments on Square hardware or online using any Internet-connected device.
Accept contactless payments with your iPhone and the Mobile Payments SDK without additional hardware.
Newly created accounts only have this single location, but more locations can be created.
